sources.citation: Prana, Treude, Thung, Atapattu, Lo, Categorizing the Content of GitHub README Files, EMSE 24:1296-1327, 2019
sources.shows: 4,226 README sections from 393 repos annotated into eight categories; classifier F1 0.746; what/how content common, purpose/status often missing.
sources.doesNotShow: Nothing about how READMEs are read or rendered.

sources.citation: Venigalla, Chimalakonda et al., An Empirical Study On Correlation between Readme Content and Project Popularity, arXiv:2206.10772, 2022
sources.shows: 1,950 READMEs, ten languages: popular projects' READMEs use lists, images and outward links; contribution guidelines and references associate with popularity.
sources.doesNotShow: Correlation only; popularity is not comprehension; direction of cause unknown; author list incompletely recorded.

sources.citation: Trockman, Zhou, Kästner, Vasilescu, Adding Sparkle to Social Coding, ICSE 2018
sources.shows: 294,941 repos: build/coverage/dependency badges are mostly reliable signals correlating with tests, PRs, fresher deps; survey respondents say too many badges look cluttered.
sources.doesNotShow: Effects do not always persist; correlational; effect of badge count not verified from results.

sources.citation: GitHub Changelog, Specify theme context for images in Markdown (Beta), 2022-05-19
sources.shows: GitHub documents <picture> with prefers-color-scheme sources.
sources.doesNotShow: Did not show the #gh-dark-mode-only fragment in the text fetched.

sources.citation: Williams, How to make your images in Markdown on GitHub adjust for dark mode and light mode, GitHub Blog, 2025-04-18
sources.shows: Recommends <picture>; does not mention the fragment syntax.
sources.doesNotShow: Silence is not a deprecation notice.

sources.citation: Judis, How to define dark/light mode images in GitHub Markdown
sources.shows: Secondary claim that the #gh-dark-mode-only fragment predates picture and is GitHub-only.
sources.doesNotShow: Not fetched; GitHub's own status of the fragment is unverified.

sources.citation: GitHub Docs, Basic writing and formatting syntax (github/docs source)
sources.shows: Alerts (five types, one or two per article, not nestable), section-link rules, emoji codes, picture supported, footnote syntax.
sources.doesNotShow: No fragment-image syntax; no statement on copy or render internals.

sources.citation: Enders, Zebra Striping: Does it Really Help?, A List Apart, 2008
sources.shows: 244 online participants, 15x9 table: no significant accuracy difference, mixed speed, 46% preferred stripes, 33% no preference.
sources.doesNotShow: Web experiment with unfamiliar data, one table; the article points to a peer-reviewed paper that was not read.

sources.citation: Enders, Zebra Striping: More Data for the Case, A List Apart, 2008
sources.shows: 2,276 analysed participants, eight timed questions, plain/lined/striped: stripes improved accuracy on 3 of 8 questions, no harm. Questions were under a 15-second limit.
sources.doesNotShow: Author lists limits: few questions, contrast/stripe width not varied, no individual analysis.

sources.citation: GitHub Changelog, New Markdown extension: Alerts..., 2023-12-14
sources.shows: Date 2023-12-14 (fetched in the skeptic pass): presented as a new feature, no earlier beta mentioned; the 2022 beta was a different syntax.
sources.doesNotShow: Page not fetched.

sources.citation: Obsidian Help, Callouts (obsidian-help source)
sources.shows: [!type] marker, titles, +/- fold marker, nesting.

sources.citation: Material for MkDocs, Admonitions (source)
sources.shows: Admonition and pymdownx.details extensions required; !!! syntax.

sources.citation: Docusaurus, Admonitions (source)
sources.shows: :::type syntax.

sources.citation: Wogalter, Jarrard, Simpson, Influence of Warning Label Signal Words on Perceived Hazard Level, Human Factors 36(3), 1994
sources.shows: 135 participants, household product labels: a signal word raises perceived hazard; extreme words differ; note/caution/warning not reliably different.
sources.doesNotShow: Consumer labels, not documentation; publisher page 403. Middle-word result not verified from the retrieved abstract (skeptic pass); on-screen notes not tested.

sources.citation: Anderson et al., How Polymorphic Warnings Reduce Habituation in the Brain, CHI 2015
sources.shows: fMRI: sharp drop in visual-processing response by the second exposure to a warning; polymorphic warning resists.
sources.doesNotShow: Security dialogs, not in-flow callouts; ACM page 403.

sources.citation: Anderson, Vance, Kirwan, Jenkins, Eargle, From Warning to Wallpaper, JMIS 33(3), 2016
sources.shows: fMRI n=25 and cursor-tracking n=80: variable-appearance warnings resist habituation.
sources.doesNotShow: Security warnings only.

sources.citation: Google, Notices, developer documentation style guide
sources.shows: Note/caution/warning definitions; readers skip notices; don't cluster; no required steps in notes.
sources.doesNotShow: No reader test cited.

sources.citation: Nielsen Norman Group, Accordions on Desktop: When and How to Use
sources.shows: Accordions help as a table of contents, hurt findability with weak headings, wrong for continuous reading.
sources.doesNotShow: Cites no experiment of its own.

sources.citation: GitHub Docs, Organizing information with collapsed sections (source)
sources.shows: details collapsed by default, open attribute, blank line after summary for markdown body.

sources.citation: MDN browser-compat-data 8.1.3
sources.shows: details search_match_opens: Chrome 97, Firefox 139 partial and 148 full, Safari 26.2 partial (scroll bug).
sources.doesNotShow: Spec text not fetched.

sources.citation: GitHub Docs, Creating diagrams (source)
sources.shows: mermaid, GeoJSON, TopoJSON, ASCII STL fences render.
sources.doesNotShow: Does not say how; iframe sandboxing not verified for GitHub.

sources.citation: GitLab MR 74414, Render GFM Mermaid diagrams in a sandboxed iframe
sources.shows: GitLab sandboxes Mermaid in an iframe.
sources.doesNotShow: GitLab, not GitHub; not fetched.

sources.citation: Mermaid, Usage: securityLevel (source)
sources.shows: strict (default), antiscript, loose, sandbox; sandbox is iframe-based and marked beta.

sources.citation: GitHub Advisory Database, Mermaid XSS entries (CVE-2025-54880, -54881, CVE-2026-41149, -41159)
sources.shows: Repeated XSS/HTML-injection advisories in Mermaid; sandbox mitigates classDef issue; 41159 is a default-configuration CSS injection (fontFamily/themeCSS), fixed in 10.9.6 and 11.15.0.
sources.doesNotShow: Advisories not read in full.

sources.shows: mermaid 12.0.0 MIT with elkjs ^0.9.3 as a hard dependency (all 0.9.x are EPL-2.0 only; the EPL-2.0 OR GPL-3.0-or-later dual licence is elkjs 0.12.0); d3 ISC; dompurify MPL-2.0 OR Apache-2.0; khroma MIT (repo licence file). scripts/gate-licences.mjs classifies EPL-2.0 unknown and the dual copyleft.
sources.doesNotShow: Whether elkjs can be excluded from a bundle not verified.

sources.citation: github-slugger 2.0.0
sources.shows: Slug = lowercase, strip generated character class, spaces to hyphens, -n suffix; ISC.
sources.doesNotShow: Community port; equivalence to GitHub's private implementation not checked.

sources.citation: CommonMark 0.31.2 and GFM 0.29-gfm specs
sources.shows: Zero occurrences of 'emoji' in either spec.

sources.doesNotShow: A feature request, not documentation of the button.

sources.shows: Copy only prompt lines with prompt stripped when any exist, else the whole block; can use highlighter prompt classes.
sources.doesNotShow: No reader error-rate data.

spec.default: Consecutive image-only links (2+) collapse to one muted small-size line of alt texts joined by a middle dot; links kept; per-host consent loads them on the grid at line height
spec.why: Blocked badges lose their value; a hidden row looks like breakage; badge volume reads as clutter
spec.marxyToday: open — each badge is a bare alt-text anchor (goldens/02-readme-real-world.html.txt)

spec.default: Honour align (left, center, right) on div/p/h1-h6 and width/height on img in the default policy; images inline, never floated
spec.why: Inert enum attributes with no URL; without them heroes collapse to left-aligned text

spec.default: Resolve <picture> by prefers-color-scheme source and #gh-dark/light-mode-only fragments against Marxy's active theme to a single img; fetch only the shown variant
spec.why: A light-theme logo on #151412 is unreadable and both fragment variants currently show
spec.marxyToday: contradicted — source removed, fallback img only, fragment images show in both themes

spec.default: None; whitespace grouping; header by weight
spec.why: Two mixed web experiments; gains only on long wide tables

spec.default: Label-first run-in head (type word, semibold, body size), marker hidden, no box/fill/icon; title replaces type word; Warning/Caution may take the accent on the label only
spec.why: Signal word carries hazard perception; habituation and style guides argue for few, quiet callouts
spec.marxyToday: contradicted — literal [!NOTE] in a plain blockquote

spec.why: Not markdown; site-plugin syntax; degrade legibly

spec.default: Honour authored open state; summary as bold run-in line with a text glyph; Find opens closed ancestors; open-all is a view state
spec.why: Convergent tool behaviour; NN/g practitioner guidance; no controlled study
spec.marxyToday: contradicted — details transparent and rendered open; under WIDE_POLICY a markdown body escapes the element

spec.default: Source plus one muted caption 'mermaid · diagram source' for diagram languages
spec.why: Prevents a reader concluding the README is broken; costs one line

spec.default: Bundled offline, sandboxed frame reading back SVG only, allow-listed SVG shown via img, height snapped to 15px multiples, themed from tokens, source one step away
spec.why: Mermaid's advisory history makes sandboxing by construction mandatory
spec.marxyToday: open — out of scope for v1; blocked by elkjs EPL-2.0 (not on the gate's permissive list)

spec.default: id = github-slugger algorithm with -n duplicate suffix; no visible permalink
spec.why: Authors write intra-document links against GitHub slugs
spec.marxyToday: open — no heading ids in goldens; specified in docs/design/02-render.md

spec.default: Convert :name: in text nodes only from a bundled MIT table; buffer and copy keep the shortcode
spec.why: Author sees a glyph; not in CommonMark or GFM

spec.default: Verbatim block render; 'Copy command' offered only when a prompt line exists; strips $/% (and # only in console langs); keeps continuations and heredocs; no trailing newline
spec.why: GitHub's copy button copies the $; sphinx-copybutton rule is the converged workable one
spec.marxyToday: open — copy-code-clean copies verbatim with trailing newline

operations.title: Copy command (strip prompts)
operations.why: A shell-session block copies with its prompts and output; the command alone is what a reader wants. Offered only when a prompt line exists; no trailing newline; refuses on terminal-affecting Unicode.

operations.title: Copy section includes closed details and alert markers
operations.why: Existing copy-section must return the full source range, closed <details> and [!NOTE] marker included; a test, not a new operation.

gaps.what: Alignment, sized images, closed details and picture variants in the default view
gaps.detail: ADR-0009 §2 names img, details and div align as opt-in widening; packages/core/src/sanitize/ is CODEOWNERS-gated (ADR-0028); 13-trust.md designs WIDE_POLICY with align/width/height and keeps source absent
gaps.proposal: Amend ADR-0009: inert attributes (align, width, height) and details/summary move to the default list; add source with a parsed single-URL srcset and only the two prefers-color-scheme media values; run the vector suite under both policies

gaps.what: Markdown body inside <details> escapes the element under WIDE_POLICY
gaps.detail: CommonMark HTML blocks end at a blank line; the pipeline has no pairing pass across sibling nodes; islands carry no provenance
gaps.proposal: Pipeline pass that wraps siblings between an unbalanced details open and close in one element with provenance from open to close; no contract change

gaps.what: Alert recognition without an AST node
gaps.detail: ast.ts contract is frozen (pinned hash); class and data-attribute names need scripts/registry.json entries
gaps.proposal: Render-time recogniser adding registry-named class/attribute; a real admonition node would need an ADR touching only contracts

gaps.detail: A new class name on the paragraph needs a registry entry first
gaps.proposal: Register marxy-badges (or equivalent) and add the render pass

gaps.detail: --marxy-* token names and units are frozen; a new token needs an ADR
gaps.proposal: Do nothing in v1; revisit if taste review finds long tables hard to track

gaps.detail: Mermaid is out of scope for v1; mermaid 12.0.0 hard-depends on elkjs ^0.9.3 (EPL-2.0; only 0.12.0 is EPL-2.0 OR GPL-3.0-or-later); EPL-2.0 is not in PERMISSIVE in scripts/gate-licences.mjs (unknown, fails), so ADR-0006's gate rejects it; advisory history demands sandboxing
gaps.proposal: Verify whether elkjs is excludable from a bundle, or amend ADR-0006 to admit EPL-2.0; otherwise no Mermaid until a licence-clean renderer exists; design the sandbox to the six requirements in section 6

gaps.what: Relative links and anchors do not work
gaps.detail: followLink calls shell.openExternal, not implemented in the Tauri shell; headings have no ids
gaps.proposal: Implement heading ids (github-slugger algorithm) and route relative markdown links through the index (ADR-0012)

gaps.detail: Island elements carry no data-marxy-s/e, so no operation resolves inside a hero
gaps.proposal: Give an island's wrapper element the byte range of its html node

2. gate:golden updated for 02-readme-real-world with align preserved
3. gate:no-network passes over the corpus

stories.summary: Show the dark or light logo that matches the theme

acceptance: 1. New test in render tests: picture with dark and light sources resolves to one img per theme
2. #gh-dark-mode-only image hidden under the light theme (unit test)

stories.summary: Open closed sections only when the reader does
stories.why: details currently render open with a bare summary; under the wide policy the body escapes

2. New test: Find opens closed ancestor details before scrolling
3. gate:fidelity: toggling never changes buffer bytes

stories.summary: Set GitHub alerts as a quiet labelled note

acceptance: 1. New test: five types and lower-case marker recognised, label present, marker text absent in DOM
2. gate:golden: byte ranges unchanged; copy section returns the marker
3. gate:aesthetics: warning label contrast >= 4.5:1 in both themes
stories.tasteRow: Before/after for all five alerts in dark and light; is a label-only treatment enough to notice Warning?

stories.summary: Group blocked badges into one quiet line
stories.why: Five bare alt words break the first screen
acceptance: 1. New test: consecutive badge links become one paragraph class with alts joined
2. gate:no-network unchanged
stories.tasteRow: Badge row blocked and after consent, dark and light.

stories.summary: Make heading links and relative markdown links work

acceptance: 1. Test: slugs equal github-slugger output for a fixture list, with duplicate suffixes

2. Result text has no trailing newline

stories.summary: Label a diagram fence as source

acceptance: 1. New test: mermaid, plantuml, dot, d2 fences carry the caption class; other languages do not
stories.tasteRow: Caption above a mermaid block, dark and light.

stories.why: Literal :tada: reads as a GitHub-only README
acceptance: 1. New test: shortcodes converted in text nodes, not in code spans or fences
